candidates.source_name: SEOnet - Ljubljanska borza electronic issuer disclosure system
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory channel where Slovenian listed issuers (incl. NLB d.d., the only listed domestic bank, plus bond issuers such as SID banka and other financial issuers) must publish inside information and regulated information: management board (uprava) and supervisory board (nadzorni svet) appointments, resignations, mandate renewals, AGM resolutions on supervisory board members, and the publication notices for annual reports. Timestamped and archived by doc_id, so past leadership moves can be reconstructed exactly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the issuer-announcement listing on a daily schedule; announcements are addressable by stable ?doc_id= permalinks (e.g. https://seonet.ljse.si/?doc_id=92568), so incremental crawling by doc_id plus issuer filter works. Keep original SL text and any EN parallel filing.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on 'SEOnet Ljubljanska borza objava sprememba uprave banke' plus snowball from NLB annual-report announcement hit
queries_used: SEOnet Ljubljanska borza objava sprememba uprave banke
letno poročilo banke 2025 organizacijska struktura število zaposlenih uprava NLB

candidates.source_name: AJPES JOLP - Javna objava letnih poročil (public disclosure of annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory archive of filed annual reports for ALL Slovenian legal entities including banks, savings banks (hranilnice) and payment-sector companies (Bankart, fintechs, ISVs). Filed reports carry the audited employee-number disclosures (povprečno število zaposlenih po izobrazbenih skupinah), employee-cost notes, and the business report section describing organisational structure. This is the only place non-listed banks/hranilnice and payment vendors are systematically captured. Public disclosure of FY2025 reports occurred 2026-08-05.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Free account registration; then targeted per-entity retrieval of PDF annual reports. NOTE a documented throttle of ~20 business entities viewed per username per day - build a target list of ~30 banking/payments entities and rotate collection across days, or collect once yearly right after the August publication date.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search 'AJPES javna objava letnih poročil banke JOLP register'
queries_used: AJPES javna objava letnih poročil banke JOLP register
candidates.observed_blocker: Documented daily view limit of 20 business entities per username (stated in AJPES JOLP help); not a hard block, a throughput constraint.

candidates.source_name: AJPES ePRS - Poslovni register Slovenije (business register, person search)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative register of legal entities and their zastopniki (legal representatives / management board members) and supervisory body members. Lets a named banker be resolved to every entity where they hold a board/representative role, and lets a bank's current board be checked against a filing. The strongest identity-resolution backbone for A5 leadership tracking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Entity-side lookups are open; the person search (default_osebe.asp) requires a name plus tax number/EMSO/address combination, so use it as a confirmation tool, not a bulk-scrape target. Bulk entity data also available as open data via podatki.gov.si.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search 'AJPES ePRS poslovni register zastopniki družbe podatki člani uprave'
queries_used: AJPES ePRS poslovni register zastopniki družbe podatki člani uprave iskanje
candidates.observed_blocker: Person-search requires identifying data (tax number / EMSO / address) alongside the name, per AJPES personal-data protection FAQ.

candidates.source_name: AJPES eObjave - court register entries and insolvency/statutory publications
candidates.why_relevant: Official publication of court-register (sodni register) entries - including changes of representatives and statutory bodies, mergers and status changes. A merger such as Nova KBM into SKB/OTP, or a board change at a non-listed bank, leaves a dated legal trace here even when nothing appears on SEOnet.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled search of eObjave filtered by the target banking/payments entity list; capture publication date + entry type.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from AJPES portal navigation surfaced in register search
queries_used: AJPES ePRS poslovni register zastopniki družbe podatki člani uprave iskanje

candidates.source_name: NLB Group investor relations - annual reports and financial reports
candidates.why_relevant: NLB is Slovenia's largest bank and the only domestically listed one. Its annual report carries group headcount (8,107 employees at end-2025 per the FY2025 report coverage), branch counts, the corporate governance statement (izjava o upravljanju), management/supervisory board composition and tenure tables, and the remuneration report with named board pay. Parallel SL and EN editions make it the reference document for the whole cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull (SL + EN) each spring; parse the corporate governance and employee sections; also subscribe to the investor-news page for interim board-change releases.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on annual-report terms, snowballed via SEOnet announcement

candidates.source_name: NLB Pillar 3 / Razkritja po 3. stebru baselskih standardov
candidates.why_relevant: Pillar 3 disclosure carries the CRR-mandated remuneration tables: numbers of identified staff (zaposleni s posebno naravo dela), headcount in high-earner bands, split by business line, plus board recruitment/suitability policy. This is quantitative staffing structure that never appears in press coverage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF fetch alongside the annual report; extract remuneration and identified-staff templates (EU REM1-REM5).

negative_findings.description: Searching in Slovenian for SEOnet announcements specifically about bank management-board changes ('objava sprememba uprave banke') returned only generic descriptions of the SEOnet system and unrelated portal pages, not a retrievable list of board-change filings.
negative_findings.result_summary: SEOnet clearly exists and archives issuer notices by ?doc_id=, but its announcement corpus is not well indexed by general web search; two individual doc_id permalinks surfaced, no searchable topical listing did.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SEOnet must be harvested by crawling its own issuer/date filters rather than via search engines; a search-engine-only strategy would miss most board-change filings.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated investor/annual-report landing page was surfaced for several smaller Slovenian deposit-takers - Delavska hranilnica, Addiko Bank Slovenija, Banka Sparkasse, Dezelna banka Slovenije, Hranilnica LON, Primorska hranilnica Vipava, BKS Bank AG branch - despite explicit local-language searching naming them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches named these institutions but returned aggregator and news pages rather than their own statutory-disclosure pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These institutions still file with AJPES, so the archival record exists; it just has to be reached through JOLP rather than their own sites. Recording them as absent from the source map would be wrong.

negative_findings.description: The Slovenian phrase 'izjava o upravljanju druzbe' (corporate governance statement) did not by itself surface standalone governance-statement documents for SI banks in this run; such statements appear to be embedded as chapters inside the annual report PDFs rather than published as separate files.
negative_findings.result_summary: No separate governance-statement document located for any SI bank.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must parse governance statements out of the annual report PDF rather than expecting a discrete document per bank.

negative_findings.description: No source in this cell was fetched or verified for liveness; all URLs come from search-result metadata and content excerpts. Some deep PDF links are year-specific and will change (e.g. the Intesa Sanpaolo path embeds both a publication year and a report year).
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence scores, not verification claims.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic verification pass must treat deep PDF links as volatile and prefer the listing-page URL as the durable entry point.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller SI banks and savings banks (Delavska hranilnica, Addiko Bank Slovenija, Banka Sparkasse, Dezelna banka Slovenije, Hranilnica LON, Primorska hranilnica Vipava, N banka legacy entity, BKS Bank branch) have no mapped statutory-disclosure landing page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-institution local-language site search using the exact Slovenian page titles found at Gorenjska banka ('letna porocila in razkritja dodatnih informacij') and OTP ('notranje upravljanje', 'uprava banke', 'nadzorni svet'); for any that still lack a page, register the entity in the AJPES JOLP collection list instead.

coverage_gaps.description: The payments half of sector=both is represented only by Bankart. Other SI payments/fintech filers - licensed payment institutions, e-money issuers, account information service providers listed in the BSI register, plus card/POS vendors and processing ISVs - have no filings mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the full non-bank payment-services entity list from the BSI Register subjektov nadzora, join it to the OPSI business-register bulk dataset, and route each entity to AJPES JOLP for its filed annual report and headcount.

coverage_gaps.description: Standalone remuneration reports ('porocilo o prejemkih') under the SI implementation of SRD II were not separately located for any bank; only Pillar 3 remuneration templates and in-annual-report sections were found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search SEOnet specifically for AGM materials ('gradivo za skupscino', 'porocilo o prejemkih clanov organov vodenja in nadzora') for NLB, and check whether other issuers publish them as AGM annexes rather than standalone files.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell rests almost entirely on NLB, which publishes parallel EN filings; most other SI banks' statutory documents appear to exist in Slovenian only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for SL-native parsing (diacritics, declensions of 'uprava/uprave/upravo', 'zaposleni/zaposlenih') rather than relying on EN editions; treat EN availability as the exception.

coverage_gaps.description: AJPES JOLP is the backbone of this cell but imposes a documented ~20-entity-per-day per-username view limit and requires registration, which constrains any bulk annual sweep.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design an annual staged sweep starting immediately after the JOLP publication date (FY2025 was published 2026-08-05), prioritising banks first and payments entities second; consider whether an AJPES paid data-service subscription is warranted for the entity list rather than working around the limit.

brief: Slovenia's statutory-disclosure record for banking and payments staffing rests on three pillars: SEOnet at the Ljubljana Stock Exchange for real-time regulated announcements (effectively NLB plus bond issuers), AJPES JOLP and ePRS as the universal filed-report and representative register covering every non-listed bank, savings bank and payments company, and the banks' own investor pages carrying annual reports plus Pillar 3 'razkritja po 3. stebru' with CRR remuneration and identified-staff tables. Banka Slovenije's Register subjektov nadzora defines the entity universe and should drive the collection target list; SDH's capital-investment report adds the state-appointment trail for NLB and SID banka. Coverage is strongest for NLB, OTP, UniCredit, Intesa Sanpaolo, SID and Gorenjska banka and thinnest for the small hranilnice and the non-bank payment institutions, which must be reached through AJPES rather than their own sites. Everything of substance is Slovenian-language and mostly PDF, so parsing must be SL-native and the AJPES ~20-entity daily view cap has to be designed around.
